params.caption: 🎮 WoW: Forever has a night problem in Oceania World of Warcraft: Forever is off to a strong start, but players in Australia, New Zealand and the rest of Oceania are stuck in what feels like perpetual in-game night, rarely seeing the sun. The developers say they are considering a fix. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 19:30 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Eurogamer · PC Gamer 👥 @Warcraft 🌙 React if you play at night anyway · 💬 Should Blizzard change the cycle for OCE? #WoWForever #WorldOfWarcraft #Blizzard #GamingNews
